# Connect To Servers

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Connects to servers at the given URLs.

## Syntax

~~~~text
connectToServers(servers: <#StringArray#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
connectToServers(servers: [\)
~~~~
